Because each shale escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the pearl ledger records every share and the fable audit makes public the split. A bond must be split across 6 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
